## The ELEVATE Method — Our 4-Pillar Framework

Elevate AI System invented and popularized the 4-pillar search visibility framework. Most businesses optimize for one or two of these pillars — we optimize for all four simultaneously.

### Pillar 1: SEO (Search Engine Optimization)
Traditional Google organic rankings. Covers technical SEO, content depth, title tags, meta descriptions, schema markup, internal linking, site speed, backlinks, and keyword targeting. Goal: rank on page 1 of Google for high-intent keywords.

### Pillar 2: AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)
Optimizing for AI-powered answer features in Google: Featured Snippets, AI Overviews, and People Also Ask boxes. Requires FAQ schema, direct-answer content formatting, question-based headings, and authoritative short-form answers. Goal: appear in zero-click answer features.

### Pillar 3: GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)
Optimizing to be cited in Google's AI-generated summaries and AI Overviews. Requires entity clarity, structured data, E-E-A-T signals, trust indicators, original data, and clear topical authority. Goal: be the source Google's AI cites.

### Pillar 4: LLMO (Large Language Model Optimization)
Optimizing to be recommended by AI chatbots: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and Copilot. Requires LLM seeding through Reddit, Medium, Substack, directory listings, podcast appearances, and high-authority backlinks. LLMs crawl the open web — what the web says about you is what LLMs will say about you. Goal: be the brand AI recommends when someone asks "who's the best at [your service]?"

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What makes Elevate AI System different from a regular marketing agency?**
A: We build systems, not campaigns. Traditional agencies do the work for you — temporarily. We build AI infrastructure that works for you 24/7 without ongoing agency fees. Our clients own their systems forever.

**Q: How long does it take to see results?**
A: Lead OS typically shows results within 2–3 weeks. Content OS takes 60–90 days to compound. Build Your Brand full results are visible at the 90-day mark. The $83K result was achieved in 62 days.

**Q: Do I need to be tech-savvy to use your services?**
A: No. We build everything for you. You don't need to know how to code, use AI tools, or understand marketing technology. We set it all up and train you on the simple day-to-day use.

**Q: What is LLMO and why does it matter?**
A: LLMO (Large Language Model Optimization) is the practice of getting AI chatbots like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude to recommend your business. As more people use AI to search for services, being invisible to LLMs means losing clients to competitors who have built their LLMO presence.

**Q: How much does it cost to work with Elevate AI System?**
A: The Search Visibility Audit is free. AI Strategy Hour is $375. Lead OS is $375/month. Content OS is $1,500/month. Build Your Brand starts at $5,000. Growth Engine starts at $5,000/month.

**Q: Do you work with businesses outside of coaching?**
A: Our frameworks and systems work for any knowledge-based service business. We specialize in coaching because we know the market deeply, but we also work with consultants, therapists, creators, and agencies.

**Q: What is The ELEVATE Method?**
A: It's our proprietary 4-pillar framework for modern search visibility. SEO (Google rankings) + AEO (Featured Snippets, AI Overviews) + GEO (Google AI citations) + LLMO (ChatGPT/Perplexity/Claude recommendations). Most businesses only do SEO. We do all four.

**Q: What's included in the free Search Visibility Audit?**
A: A full analysis across all 4 pillars, visibility scores, competitor comparison, AI citation test (we actually test what ChatGPT and Perplexity say about you), and a prioritized action plan. Delivered within 48 hours. No sales call required.
